Adds SEK 12.74M equity via set-off; dilutive to existing holders but strengthens balance sheet.
Up to 100M shares to Interlace at SEK 0.1274
Related-party set-off issue; requires high approval, signals insider-backed financing and dilution.
Reduces near-term selling pressure from new shares.
Enables future issuance capacity; potential for further dilution.
Pricing aligned with prior trading range; limits discount arbitrage.
